en.text: At that time, Herod the tetrarch heard the report concerning Jesus,

zhSimplified.text: 那时，分封的王希律听见耶稣的名声，

zhTraditional.text: 那時，分封的王希律聽見耶穌的名聲，

en.text: and said to his servants, “This is John the Baptizer. He is risen from the dead. That is why these powers work in him.”

zhSimplified.text: 就对臣仆说：「这是施洗的约翰从死里复活，所以这些异能从他里面发出来。」

zhTraditional.text: 就對臣僕說：「這是施洗的約翰從死裏復活，所以這些異能從他裏面發出來。」

en.text: For Herod had arrested John, bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife.

zhSimplified.text: 起先，希律为他兄弟腓力的妻子希罗底的缘故，把约翰拿住，锁在监里。

zhTraditional.text: 起先，希律為他兄弟腓力的妻子希羅底的緣故，把約翰拿住，鎖在監裏。

en.text: For John said to him, “It is not lawful for you to have her.”

zhSimplified.text: 因为约翰曾对他说：「你娶这妇人是不合理的。」

zhTraditional.text: 因為約翰曾對他說：「你娶這婦人是不合理的。」

en.text: When he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.

zhSimplified.text: 希律就想要杀他，只是怕百姓，因为他们以约翰为先知。

zhTraditional.text: 希律就想要殺他，只是怕百姓，因為他們以約翰為先知。

en.text: But when Herod’s birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced among them and pleased Herod.

zhSimplified.text: 到了希律的生日，希罗底的女儿在众人面前跳舞，使希律欢喜。

zhTraditional.text: 到了希律的生日，希羅底的女兒在眾人面前跳舞，使希律歡喜。

en.text: Therefore he promised with an oath to give her whatever she should ask.

zhSimplified.text: 希律就起誓，应许随她所求的给她。

zhTraditional.text: 希律就起誓，應許隨她所求的給她。

en.text: She, being prompted by her mother, said, “Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptizer.”

zhSimplified.text: 女儿被母亲所使，就说：「请把施洗约翰的头放在盘子里，拿来给我。」

zhTraditional.text: 女兒被母親所使，就說：「請把施洗約翰的頭放在盤子裏，拿來給我。」

en.text: The king was grieved, but for the sake of his oaths and of those who sat at the table with him, he commanded it to be given,

zhSimplified.text: 王便忧愁，但因他所起的誓，又因同席的人，就吩咐给她；

zhTraditional.text: 王便憂愁，但因他所起的誓，又因同席的人，就吩咐給她；

en.text: and he sent and beheaded John in the prison.

zhSimplified.text: 于是打发人去，在监里斩了约翰，

zhTraditional.text: 於是打發人去，在監裏斬了約翰，

en.text: His head was brought on a platter and given to the young lady; and she brought it to her mother.

zhSimplified.text: 把头放在盘子里，拿来给了女子；女子拿去给她母亲。

zhTraditional.text: 把頭放在盤子裏，拿來給了女子；女子拿去給她母親。

en.text: His disciples came, took the body, and buried it. Then they went and told Jesus.

zhSimplified.text: 约翰的门徒来，把尸首领去埋葬了，就去告诉耶稣。 （可6·30—44；路9·10—17；约6·1—14）

zhTraditional.text: 約翰的門徒來，把屍首領去埋葬了，就去告訴耶穌。 （可6‧30－44；路9‧10－17；約6‧1－14）

en.text: Now when Jesus heard this, he withdrew from there in a boat to a deserted place apart. When the multitudes heard it, they followed him on foot from the cities.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣听见了，就上船从那里独自退到野地里去。众人听见，就从各城里步行跟随他。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌聽見了，就上船從那裏獨自退到野地裏去。眾人聽見，就從各城裏步行跟隨他。

en.text: Jesus went out, and he saw a great multitude. He had compassion on them and healed their sick.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣出来，见有许多的人，就怜悯他们，治好了他们的病人。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌出來，見有許多的人，就憐憫他們，治好了他們的病人。

en.text: When evening had come, his disciples came to him, saying, “This place is deserted, and the hour is already late. Send the multitudes away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves food.”

zhSimplified.text: 天将晚的时候，门徒进前来，说：「这是野地，时候已经过了，请叫众人散开，他们好往村子里去，自己买吃的。」

zhTraditional.text: 天將晚的時候，門徒進前來，說：「這是野地，時候已經過了，請叫眾人散開，他們好往村子裏去，自己買吃的。」

en.text: But Jesus said to them, “Theydon’ t need to go away. You give them something to eat.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「不用他们去，你们给他们吃吧！」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「不用他們去，你們給他們吃吧！」

en.text: They told him, “We only have here five loaves and two fish.”

zhSimplified.text: 门徒说：「我们这里只有五个饼，两条鱼。」

zhTraditional.text: 門徒說：「我們這裏只有五個餅，兩條魚。」

en.text: He said, “Bringthem here to me.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「拿过来给我。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「拿過來給我。」

en.text: He commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass; and he took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, broke and gave the loaves to the disciples; and the disciples gave to the multitudes.

zhSimplified.text: 于是吩咐众人坐在草地上，就拿着这五个饼，两条鱼，望着天祝福，擘开饼，递给门徒，门徒又递给众人。

zhTraditional.text: 於是吩咐眾人坐在草地上，就拿着這五個餅，兩條魚，望着天祝福，擘開餅，遞給門徒，門徒又遞給眾人。

en.text: They all ate and were filled. They took up twelve baskets full of that which remained left over from the broken pieces.

zhSimplified.text: 他们都吃，并且吃饱了，把剩下的零碎收拾起来，装满了十二个篮子。

zhTraditional.text: 他們都吃，並且吃飽了，把剩下的零碎收拾起來，裝滿了十二個籃子。

en.text: Those who ate were about five thousand men, in addition to women and children.

zhSimplified.text: 吃的人，除了妇女孩子，约有五千。 （可6·45—52；约6·15—21）

zhTraditional.text: 吃的人，除了婦女孩子，約有五千。 （可6‧45－52；約6‧15－21）

en.text: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go ahead of him to the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣随即催门徒上船，先渡到那边去，等他叫众人散开。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌隨即催門徒上船，先渡到那邊去，等他叫眾人散開。

en.text: After he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into the mountain by himself to pray. When evening had come, he was there alone.

zhSimplified.text: 散了众人以后，他就独自上山去祷告。到了晚上，只有他一人在那里。

zhTraditional.text: 散了眾人以後，他就獨自上山去禱告。到了晚上，只有他一人在那裏。

en.text: But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, distressed by the waves, for the wind was contrary.

zhSimplified.text: 那时船在海中，因风不顺，被浪摇撼。

zhTraditional.text: 那時船在海中，因風不順，被浪搖撼。

en.text: In the fourth watch of the night, Jesus came to them, walking on the sea.

footnotes.text: 14:25 The night was equally divided into four watches, so the fourth watch is approximately 3:00 a.m. to sunrise.

zhSimplified.text: 夜里四更天，耶稣在海面上走，往门徒那里去。

zhTraditional.text: 夜裏四更天，耶穌在海面上走，往門徒那裏去。

en.text: When the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, “It’s a ghost!” and they cried out for fear.

zhSimplified.text: 门徒看见他在海面上走，就惊慌了，说：「是个鬼怪！」便害怕，喊叫起来。

zhTraditional.text: 門徒看見他在海面上走，就驚慌了，說：「是個鬼怪！」便害怕，喊叫起來。

en.text: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t beafraid.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣连忙对他们说：「你们放心，是我，不要怕！」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌連忙對他們說：「你們放心，是我，不要怕！」

en.text: Peter answered him and said, “Lord, if it is you, command me to come to you on the waters.”

zhSimplified.text: 彼得说：「主，如果是你，请叫我从水面上走到你那里去。」

zhTraditional.text: 彼得說：「主，如果是你，請叫我從水面上走到你那裏去。」

en.text: He said, “Come!” Peter stepped down from the boat and walked on the waters to come to Jesus.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「你来吧。」彼得就从船上下去，在水面上走，要到耶稣那里去；

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「你來吧。」彼得就從船上下去，在水面上走，要到耶穌那裏去；

en.text: But when he saw that the wind was strong, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, “Lord, save me!”

zhSimplified.text: 只因见风甚大，就害怕，将要沉下去，便喊着说：「主啊，救我！」

zhTraditional.text: 只因見風甚大，就害怕，將要沉下去，便喊着說：「主啊，救我！」

en.text: Immediately Jesus stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and said to him, “Youof little faith, why did you doubt?”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣赶紧伸手拉住他，说：「你这小信的人哪，为什么疑惑呢？」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌趕緊伸手拉住他，說：「你這小信的人哪，為甚麼疑惑呢？」

en.text: When they got up into the boat, the wind ceased.

zhSimplified.text: 他们上了船，风就住了。

zhTraditional.text: 他們上了船，風就住了。

en.text: Those who were in the boat came and worshiped him, saying, “You are truly the Son of God!”

zhSimplified.text: 在船上的人都拜他，说：「你真是 神的儿子了。」 （可6·53—56）

zhTraditional.text: 在船上的人都拜他，說：「你真是上帝的兒子了。」 （可6‧53－56）

en.text: When they had crossed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret.

zhSimplified.text: 他们过了海，来到革尼撒勒地方。

zhTraditional.text: 他們過了海，來到革尼撒勒地方。

en.text: When the people of that place recognized him, they sent into all that surrounding region and brought to him all who were sick;

zhSimplified.text: 那里的人一认出是耶稣，就打发人到周围地方去，把所有的病人带到他那里，

zhTraditional.text: 那裏的人一認出是耶穌，就打發人到周圍地方去，把所有的病人帶到他那裏，

en.text: and they begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment. As many as touched it were made whole.

zhSimplified.text: 只求耶稣准他们摸他的衣裳 子；摸着的人就都好了。

zhTraditional.text: 只求耶穌准他們摸他的衣裳繸子；摸着的人就都好了。
